ruling: docs/CR-DERIVED-CHECKS-PROPOSAL-2026-08-02.md §1 — Captain-ratified 2026-08-02. 'Mass' appears zero times in the Comprehensive Rules; it is a JOB word and under grammar §6b belongs to the parent layer, not to axis names. Replaced with printed CR scope composed from ratified §6 tokens (each / own / opponent / defending-player).

rule:attack-trigger-mass-damage-defendin.why: mass- retired; 'each creature defending player controls' is the printed scope (CR 506.2)

rule:attack-trigger-mass-pump-attackers.why: mass- retired; members print 'attacking creatures you control' — own-restricted, not symmetric

rule:death-trigger-mass-debuff.why: mass- retired; all 3 members print 'all creatures get -N/-N' — symmetric

rule:etb-mass-pump-your-creatures.why: mass- retired; all 7 members print 'creatures you control'

rule:mass-creature-destruction.why: mass- retired; all 14 print 'destroy all creatures'. Also fixes 'destruction' -> 'destroy': §4 lists destroy as the standardized verb and CDR-PROPOSALS §1 already ruled 'destruction' a naming violation
rule:mass-creature-destruction.definition: Destroys every creature on the battlefield regardless of controller — a symmetric board wipe. Printed as 'destroy all creatures'.

rule:mass-damage-flying-creatures-scales.why: mass- retired; both members print 'each creature with flying', symmetric

rule:mass-damage-opponents.why: mass- retired; 'each opponent' is the printed CR scope. Renaming an axis created earlier today for consistency

rule:mass-debuff-opponent-creatures.why: mass- retired; members print 'creatures your opponents control' / 'you don't control'

rule:mass-pump-your-creatures.why: mass- retired; 17 of 19 print 'creatures you control'

rule:mass-untap-your-creatures.why: mass- retired; members print 'untap all creatures you control'

rule:mass-untap-and-haste-stolen-creatur.why: mass- retired AND it was never a mass effect: all 14 members print 'Untap THAT creature. It gains haste' — a single stolen creature, singular. The mass- prefix asserted a breadth no member has
rule:mass-untap-and-haste-stolen-creatur.definition: After gaining control of a creature, untaps that creature and grants it haste so it can attack immediately. Singular: the effect applies to the one creature whose control changed, not to a board.

rule:mass-graveyard-exile.why: mass- retired; the symmetric members print 'exile all cards from graveyards'. The 5 members that instead print 'target card' are an open C4f finding and are NOT resolved by this rename
